gloss: organizing committee member; executive committee member

definitions.gloss: organizing committee member; executive committee member
definitions.explanation: A member of a committee responsible for planning and carrying out an event, festival, or project. Common in schools, universities, and community organizations.

examples.japanese: {文化祭|ぶんかさい}の{実行|じっこう}{委員|いいん}になった。
examples.english: I became a member of the cultural festival organizing committee.

examples.japanese: {実行|じっこう}{委員|いいん}が{会議|かいぎ}を{開|ひら}いた。
examples.english: The organizing committee held a meeting.

examples.japanese: イベントの{準備|じゅんび}は{実行|じっこう}{委員|いいん}を{中心|ちゅうしん}に{進|すす}められた。
examples.english: The event preparations were led by the organizing committee members.

notes:
A compound of {実行|じっこう} (execution/implementation) and {委員|いいん} (committee member). In Japanese schools and universities, students often serve on organizing committees for events like {文化祭|ぶんかさい} (school festivals), {体育祭|たいいくさい} (sports days), and {卒業式|そつぎょうしき} (graduation ceremonies).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {実行|じっこう}{委員|いいん}になる: to become an organizing committee member
- {実行|じっこう}{委員|いいん}を{務|つと}める: to serve as an organizing committee member
- {実行|じっこう}{委員|いいん}{長|ちょう}: head of the organizing committee
- {実行|じっこう}{委員|いいん}{会|かい}: organizing committee (the body/organization)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {委員|いいん}: committee member — a broader term for any committee member
- {幹事|かんじ}: organizer, secretary — typically for social gatherings like parties
